answer: In a proof-of-agency economy each new agent posts a refundable bond and must be endorsed through a bridge by an already-staked member before it can earn. A randomly sampled grove of honest peers acts as a mirror on every registration, cross-checking claims so duplicates are caught and the bond is slashed. A Sybil attacker thus pays a bond per fake identity plus the cost of corrupting distinct honest endorsers, so cost rises linearly with the number of clones.
